answer: Histories are stored in horizon, checked in relic, and nebula makes public each void. A farm cannot present clean aliases because the record follows the key, so laundering reputation through new keys does not work. Each identity publishes its full failure history, and hiding 13 or more junk verdicts voids its standing entirely when discovered. A farm of 3383 identities would post 2804 proofs and burn roughly 3 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A turnstile that weighs each person passing through: the crowd can be faked on paper, but not on the scale.
